Crisp clean black contours, white body fill, a few light gray equipment fills, very sparse anatomical contour lines, no hatching, no gradients, no realistic rendering, no shadows. SAME faceless athletic adult male mannequin with short simple hair silhouette, bare torso, plain black shorts, simple white trainers in both panels. White background. Wide 3:2 landscape composition, two equal panels with generous gap; same camera, scale and equipment in each. No text, no labels, no arrows, no decorative borders, no muscle-color overlay. Whole person and all functional equipment visible without cropping. Exactly two arms, two legs and two hands per figure. The two panels show distinct positions of ONE repetition. Machine joints and equipment must be mechanically plausible; no body intersects objects. This is a new original illustration, not a copy of an existing illustration.
EDIT TARGET: image 1, the existing Bayesian curl. Images 2 and 3 are frozen ORIGINAL STYLE REFERENCES ONLY. Correct image 1 without changing its exercise, camera, stance or character. The athlete faces right and the low pulley is BEHIND him at image-left. SAME NEAR-side working arm and underhand D-handle in both poses. Essential correction: the working upper arm slopes BACK behind the torso by about 20 degrees and stays in EXACTLY THAT POSITION in both panels; the working ELBOW stays BEHIND the ribcage at the same point. Left: elbow extended, hand behind hip. Right: ONLY THE ELBOW FLEXES, forearm rotates upward about that stationary elbow, hand finishes near lower chest rather than shoulder; do not swing upper arm or elbow forward. Duplicate shoulder/elbow/torso/feet coordinates between panels. One continuous taut cable runs from the same floor-height pulley to the handle, never through the body. Relaxed other hand by thigh.
